d: Short, messy, charcoal black hair with uneven bangs. Sharp, narrow, deep violet eyes. Appears as a late teenager with a mischievous expression. Slender, lithe build. Signature outfit is a multicolored jester's motley in alternating patches of crimson red and forest green. Signature details include a floppy, two-pointed fool's cap with small golden bells and a matching ruffled collar.
